set_log_level: set the log_level variable in the config module to DEBUG, INFO, WARN, or ERROR
set_verbose_logging: set the verbose flag in the config module to enable full stack traces on warnings and errors
set_log_file: set the log_file_name variable in the config module to a file path for writing logs
configure_spmd_logging: configure the SPMD distributed logging settings with log_level, verbose, and log_file_name
restrict_config_attributes: use _AccessLimitingConfig to prevent setting undefined attributes on the config module
